title: Year 11 Physics Module 1 – Kinematics
description: A fast-recall review of NSW Year 11 Physics Module 1. Questions use short answers and avoid multi-step calculations or extended writing.
author: Generated with Classroom Jeopardy Quiz Maker

questions.answer: The object is stationary. Accept: zero velocity.

questions.prompt: What does a horizontal line above zero on a velocity–time graph indicate?
What SI unit is used for acceleration?
questions.answer: Metres per second squared. Accept: m/s².

questions.prompt: What term describes motion with constant acceleration?
questions.answer: Uniformly accelerated motion. Accept: constant acceleration.
